dogecoin.text: @sassal0x Honestly? This is going to sound insane but $DOGE . I don't even have it in my portfolio, but people will carry that meme forever. It's a toss up which of the other SC L1 chains will win. They will outperform $DOGE, but if I'm locked in for 10 years I can't switch.

@Fiskantes @dogecoin Confidence is the primary pillar of value in a currency. In a deterritorialized monetary system, memetic power is the greatest determinant of confidence because geopolitical power is now irrelevant. Dogs are stickier than technobabble in the minds of nearly everyone.

@intocryptoverse In a sane world it would be $ADA, but this isn't one, so it's $DOGE . The fundamentals of this market are memes, but the audience here spends too much time thinking about tech. Availability bias at work.
